The '''father''' of the [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] [[Makezh]] lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eror Zeen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Danoor]]. He worked in the irrigation system underneath the city, and would often take his son along while he worked. As a result, Makezh gained a working knowledge of the system that would prove useful in later [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="GE" />
